description: This file implements a class for SambaNova's speech-to-text (STT) service using their Whisper API, providing methods for initializing the service with configuration parameters and transcribing audio data asynchronously.

classes.name: SambaNovaSTTService
classes.description: A service class for performing speech-to-text conversion leveraging SambaNova's Whisper API, extending the BaseWhisperSTTService with specific configuration and transcription logic.

methods.description: Initializes the SambaNovaSTTService with specified parameters such as model, API key, URL, language, prompt, and temperature, passing them to the base class constructor.

methods.name: Transcription _transcribe(self, audio: bytes)
methods.description: Performs asynchronous transcription of given audio bytes, constructing request parameters and invoking the client API to get the transcription result. Includes a warning if probability metrics are requested, as they are not supported.
